subject.title: 飞书话题群(Topic Group)被识别为p2p导致消息路由错误

question: Which Feishu/Lark signal should OpenClaw trust to classify topic/OpenChat messages delivered as `chat_type: "p2p"` as group/topic messages without regressing real p2p threads?
rationale: Current source proves the bug, but the obvious heuristics overlap with protected p2p direct-message behavior and adjacent Feishu routing PRs, so the permanent discriminator is a maintainer compatibility decision.

options.title: Validate an API-backed discriminator
options.body: Use Feishu/Lark chat metadata or a verified event-shape contract, then share the classifier across dispatch and mention-forward paths with focused regressions.

options.title: Accept an event-shape heuristic
options.body: Classify selected `p2p` events as group/topic based on a narrow combination of `oc_`, `thread_id`, and topic metadata, while explicitly preserving p2p-thread tests.

options.title: Adopt or replace the linked PR
options.body: Use the existing closing PR only if maintainers accept its `oc_` prefix rule and add the missing compatibility proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Validate an API-backed discriminator
recommendation.body: Use Feishu/Lark chat metadata or a verified event-shape contract, then share the classifier across dispatch and mention-forward paths with focused regressions.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent topic-session key work touched the same classifier-adjacent Feishu files and is the strongest history signal for this behavior decision.
